messages:
Priya (Product): Quick follow-ups from today's all-hands security segment—customers asked about BYOK rotation, HSM support, DSARs for hosted logs, and ISO evidence timing. Can we capture answers here?
Leah (Head of Security): Sure. I'll keep it concise.
Priya (Product): Thanks.
Leah (Head of Security): BYOK/KMS rotation: Private + Dedicated support customer-managed keys. Recommended rotation is 90 days; we won't force rewrap. We can offer an opt-in managed rotation add-on for automation.
Anya (Compliance): For SOC2/ISO evidence we'll need key rotation logs, wrap/unwrap events, and access trails. Plan to expose CSV exports in Console.
Kai (Eng-Infra): Private connects to customer KMS (AWS/GCP/Azure). On-prem HSMs supported via a KMIP connector agent; HSM GA depends on pilot results and cert checks.
Priya (Product): Timeline for HSM GA?
Jordan (CTO): Target end of Q3, two pilots in May/June. If pilots succeed we'll proceed to GA.
Sam (Privacy): DSARs: hosted API—request metadata retained per policy; request/response payloads are ephemeral unless customer opts in. Private/Dedicated—customer owns payloads; we'll provide metadata export tools.
Priya (Product): Audit log replication—can we support immutable replicas?
Kai (Eng-Infra): We'll replicate audit logs to customer destinations (S3/GCS) with versioning. WORM/immutability depends on storage provider features; we'll publish recipes.
Anya (Compliance): ISO evidence automation roadmap: export templates (June), self-serve bundles (August), auditor-access controls (September). Soft dates.
Leah (Head of Security): Action items: Leah to publish BYOK FAQ; Kai to post HSM pilot checklist + signup; Anya to publish ISO evidence timeline.
Priya (Product): Please drop links to drafts so I can share with customers.
Kai (Eng-Infra): Draft HSM design: https://internal.redwood/hsm-design (internal). Pilot signup: https://forms.redwood/hsm-pilot.
Leah (Head of Security): BYOK FAQ draft: https://internal.redwood/byok-faq.
Anya (Compliance): ISO checklist draft: https://internal.redwood/iso-evidence-checklist.
Sam (Privacy): I'll paste a short DSAR blurb in ~30m. :thumbsup:
Priya (Product): Also need a written policy stating who owns DSARs for Private deployments.
Leah (Head of Security): Policy: for Private (VPC/on-prem) where customer controls KMS/network/storage, the customer is responsible for DSAR responses for customer data. Redwood will assist with metadata exports and platform-level logs. We'll add this to the FAQ.
Jordan (CTO): Note: SLA—Dedicated/Private contracts include timeboxed assistance for DSAR exports; scope negotiable.
Kai (Eng-Infra): HSM note: when keys never leave the HSM, some forensic evidence is only in the HSM audit logs—customers must coordinate with their HSM operator.
Priya (Product): Can someone file tickets to track these tasks?
devops-bot: Created SEC-421 "Publish BYOK FAQ + policy blurb" and SEC-422 "HSM pilot checklist & signup".
Leah (Head of Security): I'll take SEC-421.
Kai (Eng-Infra): I'll take SEC-422.
Anya (Compliance): I'll open SEC-423 for ISO evidence tasks and link it here when done.
Sam (Privacy): DSAR blurb incoming in this thread shortly.
Priya (Product): Great—I'll compile a customer-facing FAQ bundle once drafts are live. Thanks everyone.
Leah (Head of Security): Closing the loop. If partners need NDA-level detail we'll coordinate via Legal.
devops-bot: Updated tickets: SEC-421 assigned to Leah, SEC-422 assigned to Kai, SEC-423 pending (Anya).
